figurative_meaning_en: Distinguished by a broad forehead like an elephant's
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার গজকপালে দেখে মনে হয় সে বুদ্ধিমান।
example_sentences_in_english: His elephantine forehead suggests he is intelligent.
The man with a broad forehead like an elephant's has a very striking appearance.
note: Refers to the auspicious broad forehead associated with elephants in traditional descriptions
